patreon.title: A closer look at one Git commit
patreon.post:
A history overview helps you locate a likely commit. Git show lets you inspect the selected record more closely: its message, metadata and textual diff.

Our checkout-button example is hypothetical. The before-and-after illustration summarizes an idea; it is not evidence of a real application’s behavior. A patch describes the recorded file changes, while the message offers the author’s written context. Neither proves every intention or runtime consequence. Inspecting the record does not edit your current files.

Takeaway: locate the commit, then inspect its details and read the message alongside the change.

Source: https://git-scm.com/docs/git-show
